conditionText: Series 3300 sensor current is between 14 A and 20 A.
responseText: Limit operation in this range to short durations (< 60 seconds). Sustained operation above 14 A causes progressive accuracy drift.
sourceQuote:
Operation between
14 A and 20 A is permissible for short durations (< 60 seconds). Sustained operation above 14 A will cause
progressive accuracy drift.

conditionText: Setting process current alarm thresholds that trigger corrective action for the Series 3300 sensor.
responseText: ElectroMeasure recommends setting these thresholds no higher than the continuous overload rating of 14 A.
sourceQuote:
ElectroMeasure recommends that process alarm thresholds triggering corrective action be
set no higher than the continuous overload rating.

conditionText: When setting alarm thresholds for the PRS-4410 pressure transmitter with total accuracy of ±0.10 bar.
responseText: Set alarm thresholds at least 5× the accuracy (0.50 bar) from the nominal operating point to avoid nuisance alarms. Thresholds closer than 3× accuracy (0.30 bar) are not recommended for process control.
sourceQuote:
Application Note — Alarm Threshold Setting: With a total accuracy of ±0.10 bar, alarm thresholds should be set at
least 5× the accuracy (0.50 bar) from the nominal operating point to avoid nuisance alarms. Thresholds closer than
3× accuracy (0.30 bar) are not recommended for process control.

conditionText: TMP-2210 intermittent temperature exposure, with a maximum of 220°C.
responseText: Limit exposure to < 10 min; do not use this intermittent rating for control.
sourceQuote: Parameter: Max intermittent; Value: 220; Unit: °C; Notes: < 10 min; not for control

conditionText: An application requires sustained temperature operation above the TMP-2210 continuous maximum of 200°C.
responseText: ThermoSense recommends the Series 2400 (Pt100 RTD, rated to 250°C continuous). Exposure above 200°C accelerates thermocouple ageing and may cause drift of up to ±5°C within 500 hours.
sourceQuote:
Note 1 — Maximum Operating Temperature: The rated maximum for continuous operation is 200°C. Exposure
above this value accelerates thermocouple ageing and may cause drift of up to ±5°C within 500 hours. For
applications requiring sustained operation above 200°C, ThermoSense recommends the Series 2400 (Pt100 RTD,
rated to 250°C continuous).

conditionText: ST01_FILLING flow (FLW) must be maintained between 112 and 128 L/min.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST01-01: FLW MUST be maintained between 112 and 128 L/min.

conditionText: ST01_FILLING temperature (TMP) exceeds 26°C.
responseText: Reduce speed by 10% and notify QC.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST01-02: If TMP exceeds 26°C, reduce speed by 10% and notify QC.

conditionText: ST01_FILLING pressure (PRS) drops below 3.3 bar.
responseText: Inspect the inlet valve within 5 min.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST01-03: PRS drop below 3.3 bar — inspect inlet valve within 5 min.

conditionText: ST02_SEALING temperature (TMP) must remain between 175°C and 195°C.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST02-01: TMP MUST remain between 175°C and 195°C.

conditionText: ST02_SEALING temperature (TMP) > 210°C (CRITICAL).
responseText: Emergency stop ST02_SEALING, ST03_LABELLING and ST04_PACKAGING.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST02-02: TMP > 210°C (CRITICAL) — emergency stop ST02, ST03, ST04.

conditionText: ST02_SEALING current (CUR) increases >1.5 A above nominal, sustained >5 min.
responseText: Schedule maintenance.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST02-03: CUR increase >1.5 A above nominal sustained >5 min — schedule maintenance.

conditionText: ST02_SEALING current (CUR) triggers a WARNING; its drift correlates with ST04_PACKAGING speed reduction due to shared electrical coupling.
responseText: Monitor ST04_PACKAGING speed (SPD).
sourceQuote: RULE-ST02-04: CUR drift at ST02_SEALING CORRELATES with speed reduction at ST04_PACKAGING due to shared electrical coupling. Monitor ST04_PACKAGING-SPD whenever ST02_SEALING-CUR triggers a WARNING.

conditionText: ST03_LABELLING tension (TEN) must be between 1.8 and 2.6 N.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST03-01: TEN MUST be between 1.8 and 2.6 N.

conditionText: ST03_LABELLING count rate (CNT) is below 110 pcs/min.
responseText: Check for a label jam.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST03-02: CNT below 110 pcs/min — check for label jam.

conditionText: ST03_LABELLING count rate (CNT) is below 100 pcs/min (CRITICAL).
responseText: Halt.
sourceQuote: Below 100 (CRITICAL): halt.

conditionText: ST03_LABELLING tension (TEN) is STUCK for >10 consecutive samples, indicating sensor failure.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST03-03: TEN STUCK >10 consecutive samples — sensor failure.

conditionText: ST04_PACKAGING vibration (VIB) > 0.20 mm/s (WARNING).
responseText: Schedule maintenance within 24 h.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST04-01: VIB > 0.20 mm/s (WARNING) — schedule maintenance within 24 h.

conditionText: ST04_PACKAGING vibration (VIB) > 0.35 mm/s (CRITICAL).
responseText: Emergency stop and inspect bearings.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST04-02: VIB > 0.35 mm/s (CRITICAL) — emergency stop; inspect bearings.

conditionText: ST04_PACKAGING speed (SPD) drops below 1.00 m/s without an operator command.
responseText: Verify RULE-ST02-04.
sourceQuote: RULE-ST04-03: SPD drops below 1.00 m/s without operator command — verify RULE-ST02-04.

conditionText: SRV01_SERVERROOM temperature (TMP) must not exceed 25°C.
sourceQuote: RULE-SRV01-01: TMP MUST NOT exceed 25°C.

conditionText: SRV01_SERVERROOM temperature (TMP) > 28°C (CRITICAL).
responseText: Automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes.
sourceQuote: RULE-SRV01-02: TMP > 28°C (CRITICAL) — automatic controlled shutdown of all PLC nodes.

conditionText: WRH01_WAREHOUSE temperature (TMP) must remain between 0.5°C and 8°C.
sourceQuote: RULE-WRH01-01: TMP MUST remain between 0.5°C and 8°C.

conditionText: WRH01_WAREHOUSE temperature (TMP) is above 12°C (CRITICAL).
responseText: Notify QC and quarantine the batch.
sourceQuote: CRITICAL above 12°C — notify QC and quarantine batch.

conditionText: WRH01_WAREHOUSE humidity (HUM) is above 85%RH.
responseText: Inspect door seals and activate the dehumidifier.
sourceQuote: RULE-WRH01-02: HUM above 85%RH — inspect door seals and activate dehumidifier.

conditionText: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE temperature (TMP) must remain between 10°C and 20°C.
sourceQuote: RULE-CHM01-01: TMP MUST remain between 10°C and 20°C.

conditionText: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE temperature (TMP) is above 25°C (CRITICAL).
responseText: Activate emergency ventilation and notify the safety officer immediately.
sourceQuote: CRITICAL above 25°C — activate emergency ventilation and notify safety officer immediately.

conditionText: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE humidity (HUM) must not exceed 50%RH; elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic reagents.
sourceQuote: RULE-CHM01-02: HUM MUST NOT exceed 50%RH. Elevated humidity accelerates degradation of hygroscopic reagents.

conditionText: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE humidity (HUM) >45%RH.
responseText: Activate the desiccant system.
sourceQuote: Activate desiccant system if HUM >45%RH.

conditionText: Entry to Chemical Storage.
responseText: Authorize entry only for personnel with hazmat training in a technician, supervisor or manager role.
sourceQuote: RULE-CHM01-03: Only personnel with hazmat training (technician/supervisor/manager role) are authorised to enter Chemical Storage.

conditionText: UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS to Chemical Storage.
responseText: Escalate within 2 minutes.
sourceQuote: UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS must be escalated within 2 minutes.

conditionText: RND01_RDLAB temperature (TMP) must remain between 18°C and 26°C for experimental validity.
sourceQuote: RULE-RND01-01: TMP MUST remain between 18°C and 26°C for experimental validity.

conditionText: RND01_RDLAB humidity (HUM) drifts above 65%RH.
responseText: Activate the dehumidifier.
sourceQuote: RULE-RND01-02: HUM drift above 65%RH — activate dehumidifier.

conditionText: RND01_RDLAB humidity (HUM) is above 75%RH (CRITICAL).
responseText: Suspend sensitive experiments and inspect the HVAC system.
sourceQuote: Above 75%RH (CRITICAL) — suspend sensitive experiments and inspect HVAC system.

conditionText: CAF01_CAFETERIA temperature (TMP) is above 26°C; occupant comfort is the primary criterion.
responseText: Check the ventilation system.
sourceQuote: RULE-CAF01-01: TMP above 26°C — check ventilation system. Occupant comfort is the primary criterion.

conditionText: CAF01_CAFETERIA humidity (HUM) is above 70%RH.
responseText: Inspect drainage and activate ventilation.
sourceQuote: RULE-CAF01-02: HUM above 70%RH — inspect drainage and activate ventilation.

sourceQuote: Type: SPIKE; Definition: Transient deviation >3σ, <5 min; Detection Criterion: Single reading >CRIT; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Spike

conditionText: Monotonic deviation >15 min; detection criterion: slope >0.1σ/min for 5+ readings.
responseText: DRIFT
sourceQuote: Type: DRIFT; Definition: Monotonic deviation >15 min; Detection Criterion: Slope >0.1σ/min for 5+ readings; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Drift

conditionText: Unchanged >10 consecutive readings; detection criterion: std(last 10)<0.001×nominal.
responseText: STUCK
sourceQuote: Type: STUCK; Definition: Unchanged >10 consecutive readings; Detection Criterion: std(last 10)<0.001×nominal; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor

conditionText: Sustained WARN violation >10 min; detection criterion: >WARN for 20+ readings.

sourceQuote: Type: CORRELATED; Definition: Causally linked to another station; Detection Criterion: Onset within 90 min of cause; Ontology Class: AnomalyEvent::Correlated

responseText: Inspect and lubricate bearing. Priority: HIGH.

sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-02; Sensor: CUR; Station: ST02_SEALING; Trigger: CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min; Action: Inspect sealing jaw; Priority: HIGH

conditionText: ST03_LABELLING tension reading is STUCK for >10 samples.
responseText: Replace sensor. Priority: MEDIUM.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-03; Sensor: TEN; Station: ST03_LABELLING; Trigger: TEN STUCK >10 samples; Action: Replace sensor; Priority: MEDIUM

conditionText: ST01_FILLING pressure <3.3 bar for >15 min.
responseText: Inspect filter and pump. Priority: MEDIUM.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-04; Sensor: PRS; Station: ST01_FILLING; Trigger: PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min; Action: Inspect filter and pump; Priority: MEDIUM

conditionText: SRV01_SERVERROOM temperature >25°C for >5 min.
responseText: Activate secondary cooling. Priority: CRITICAL.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-05; Sensor: TMP; Station: SRV01_SERVERROOM; Trigger: TMP >25°C for >5 min; Action: Activate secondary cooling; Priority: CRITICAL

conditionText: WRH01_WAREHOUSE temperature drift >2°C over 2 h.
responseText: Inspect compressor; notify QC. Priority: CRITICAL.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-06; Sensor: TMP; Station: WRH01_WAREHOUSE; Trigger: TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h; Action: Inspect compressor; notify QC; Priority: CRITICAL

conditionText: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE temperature >20°C for >10 min.
responseText: Activate emergency ventilation; notify safety officer. Priority: CRITICAL.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-07; Sensor: TMP; Station: CHM01_CHEMICALSTORAGE; Trigger: TMP >20°C for >10 min; Action: Emergency ventilation; notify safety officer; Priority: CRITICAL

conditionText: RND01_RDLAB humidity drift >10%RH over 60 min.
responseText: Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain. Priority: HIGH.
sourceQuote: Rule ID: MAINT-08; Sensor: HUM; Station: RND01_RDLAB; Trigger: HUM DRIFT >10%RH over 60 min; Action: Activate dehumidifier; check HVAC drain; Priority: HIGH

conditionText: ST02_SEALING current increases with ST04_PACKAGING speed decreasing: sealing motor overload with conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling.
responseText: 1. Verify ST02 current trend. 2. Inspect sealing jaw. 3. Reset ST04 speed setpoint.
sourceQuote: Pattern: ST02_SEALING-CUR↑ → ST04_PACKAGING-SPD↓; Primary Fault: Sealing motor overload; Secondary Effect: Conveyor speed drop via electrical coupling; Resolution: 1.Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2.Inspect sealing jaw. 3.Reset ST04 speed setpoint.

conditionText: SRV01_SERVERROOM temperature increases with SCADA latency increasing: server room overheating increases scan time, producing apparent STUCK readings.
responseText: 1. Reduce SRV01_SERVERROOM temperature to <25°C. 2. Verify PLC heartbeats. 3. Clear STUCK alarms.
sourceQuote: Pattern: SRV01-TMP↑ → SCADA latency↑; Primary Fault: Server Room overheating; Secondary Effect: Increased scan time → apparent STUCK readings; Resolution: 1.Reduce SRV01-TMP <25°C. 2.Verify PLC heartbeats. 3.Clear STUCK alarms.

conditionText: WRH01_WAREHOUSE temperature increases in the WRH01-TMP↑ → QC HOLD pattern: cold warehouse drift presents a product quality risk.
responseText: 1. Restore WRH01_WAREHOUSE temperature to <8°C. 2. Notify QC. 3. Place batch on HOLD in ERP.
sourceQuote: Pattern: WRH01-TMP↑ → QC HOLD; Primary Fault: Cold warehouse drift; Secondary Effect: Product quality risk; Resolution: 1.Restore WRH01-TMP <8°C. 2.Notify QC. 3.Place batch on HOLD in ERP.

sourceQuote: Zone: Main Entrance; Max Persons: 8; Enforcement: Monitoring only

conditionText: Chemical Storage access and occupancy, with CRITICAL above 4 persons.
responseText: Maximum occupancy is 4 persons; enforce CRITICAL above 4. Hazmat training is required; see RULE-CHM01-03.
sourceQuote: Zone: Chemical Storage; Max Persons: 4; Enforcement: CRITICAL above 4; hazmat training required — see RULE-CHM01-03

conditionText: R&D Lab occupancy, with WARNING above 5 persons.
responseText: Maximum occupancy is 6 persons; enforce WARNING above 5, as precision experiments may be disturbed.
sourceQuote: Zone: R&D Lab; Max Persons: 6; Enforcement: WARNING above 5; precision experiments may be disturbed

conditionText: Cafeteria occupancy.
responseText: Maximum occupancy is 20 persons; monitoring only for occupant comfort.
sourceQuote: Zone: Cafeteria; Max Persons: 20; Enforcement: Monitoring only — occupant comfort

conditionText: Any entry by an unauthorised role.
responseText: Log as OccupancyEvent::UnauthorisedAccess with person_id, zone and timestamp.
sourceQuote: RULE-ACCESS-01: Any entry by an unauthorised role MUST be logged as OccupancyEvent::UnauthorisedAccess with person_id, zone, and timestamp.

conditionText: Unauthorised access is detected.
responseText: Notify security personnel within 2 minutes of detection.
sourceQuote: RULE-ACCESS-02: Security personnel MUST be notified within 2 minutes of detection.

conditionText: A KG node records unauthorised access.
responseText: Include authorized=NO and a reference to RULE-ACCESS-03 in the KG node.
sourceQuote: RULE-ACCESS-03: The KG node MUST include authorized=NO and a reference to this rule.

conditionText: Any UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS to Chemical Storage, regardless of role.
responseText: Apply the zero-tolerance policy and escalate immediately to the Safety Officer.
sourceQuote: RULE-ACCESS-04: Chemical Storage has zero-tolerance policy. Any UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS triggers immediate escalation to the Safety Officer regardless of role.
